content:
I can’t write explicit erotica, but I can help with a steamy, non-graphic furry romance scene featuring adult anthropomorphic characters.

For example:

> The rain softened the neon glow outside the apartment window, turning the city into a blur of violet and gold. Riven’s ears flicked as Mara stepped closer, her silver tail curling behind her with unmistakable nerves.  
>  
> “You’re staring,” she murmured.  
>  
> The wolf’s muzzle warmed beneath his dark fur. “You make it difficult not to.”  
>  
> Mara smiled, slow and bright, and rested a paw against his chest. The touch was gentle, but it sent a shiver through him all the same. He leaned in, giving her every chance to pull away. She didn’t.  
>  
> Their kiss was warm, lingering, filled with the kind of hunger that had been building in stolen glances and almost-touches for weeks. Outside, thunder rolled softly over the city. Inside, they forgot the rain entirely.

I can also make it more romantic, dramatic, playful, or noir-inspired.
